purpose: Determine whether CPU inference runs when IPv4/IPv6 socket creation is denied to the process tree.

seccomp_probe.filter: Deny socket(AF_INET, ...) and socket(AF_INET6, ...) with EPERM; allow other syscalls.

cli_workflow.observed_error: CPU inference failed with exit 1: ... failed to get a free port

direct_module_workflow.observed_error: CPU inference failed with exit 1: ... failed to get a free port

interpretation: The filter blocked IP socket creation, but llama-cli could not complete local port setup. The reason has not been isolated; this experiment does not establish offline functionality.
limits: The seccomp probe did not isolate the cause of the local-port failure.
No device-wide network setting was changed.
The earlier malformed filter experiment was terminated and is excluded from these results.

An egress-filtered inference attempt exceeded 120 seconds and left a test-owned llama-cli child; that exact child was terminated and verified absent. This filter experiment does not establish offline functionality or normal-runtime timeout behavior.

A separate one-second timeout check without seccomp returned the expected timeout error and left no matching inference process. It confirms ordinary process-group cleanup for this bounded case; it does not validate cleanup under seccomp restrictions.

egress_seccomp_probe.filter: Deny connect, sendto, sendmsg, sendmmsg, and io_uring_setup with EPERM; permit IP socket creation and local bind.

direct_module_workflow.child_cleanup: The module did not reap the llama-cli child under this experimental filter; the exact test-owned child PID was terminated manually and verified absent.

normal_runtime_timeout_check.command: python3 import cpu_inference; run_inference(..., max_tokens=32, timeout=1)
normal_runtime_timeout_check.message: CPU inference timed out; its child process group was terminated
normal_runtime_timeout_check.post_check: No cpu_inference.py or llama-cli process remained after one second.
